findings.title: Migration 001 removes the non-negative document size invariant
evidence: seed document DDL: CHECK (size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes >= 0)
runtime document DDL after ledger version 001: size_bytes INTEGER without CHECK
findings.recommended_disposition: Design and owner-approve a corrective runtime migration that restores the exact invariant while preserving the SHA-256 check; verify on a fresh authenticated copy.
findings.exact_next_owner: documents_provenance Domain owner plus outbound SQLite migration owner

findings.title: Migration 001 removes four canonical document defaults
evidence: seed defaults: document_type OTHER, language_code fr, document_status ACTIVE, created_at CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
runtime after migration 001: all four defaults absent
findings.recommended_disposition: Restore the four defaults through the same separately approved corrective migration and assert exact DDL preservation.
findings.exact_next_owner: documents_provenance Domain owner plus outbound SQLite migration owner

findings.title: READ-15 resource_ref has no explicit bound or format
evidence: API_HANDOFF.json names resource_ref but defines no length or format
09_API_APPLICATION_DOWNSTREAM_CONSTRAINTS.md requires refs to be validated and bounded
findings.recommended_disposition: Approve one transport-neutral resource reference bound/format in the Application contract and add negative tests before HTTP materialization.

findings.title: Resource ACTIVE and CANONICAL semantics remain unresolved for the public identity_status field
evidence: ResourceIdentityStatus keeps ACTIVE and CANONICAL distinct
findings.recommended_disposition: Obtain an owner decision defining whether the values share one dimension or require separate concepts; do not infer equivalence from SQLite.

findings.title: ContextOrigin has no approved persistence representation
evidence: pedagogical_context has no origin column and notes remains pedagogical
findings.recommended_disposition: Keep origin non-persisted until a product requirement and owner-approved storage contract exist.

findings.title: CAP-R02 has a handoff but no concrete Application query or production read port
findings.recommended_disposition: Materialize after the data remediation, in delivery position 1, without exposing it in the Resource-only API slice.

findings.title: CAP-A01 has a handoff but no concrete deterministic validation command
evidence: scenario doubles do not constitute an owner use case
findings.recommended_disposition: Materialize after CAP-R02 with deterministic provider-free tests and no promotion authority.

findings.title: CAP-A02 has a handoff but no concrete gated promotion command
evidence: generic gate/idempotency components exist but no owner command
findings.recommended_disposition: Materialize last, behind a trusted Gate and effect ledger, with reconciliation-before-replay tests.

findings.title: Migration tests do not assert preservation of pre-existing document DDL
evidence: test_sqlite_runtime_real_gate.py checks SHA, count, FK, checksum and idempotence
no test compares document defaults or the size_bytes CHECK
findings.recommended_disposition: Add an allowlisted structural diff test that permits only the ledger and intended SHA constraint change.

findings.title: B09 assigns HTTP implementation to 12.17.5 while the current 12.17.5 mandate is audit-only
findings.recommended_disposition: Treat the current audit mandate as authoritative and correct phase ownership in the next documentary lot.

findings.title: Historical mypy debt remains 15 diagnostics in 10 files
findings.recommended_disposition: Keep historical sources outside the active graph and monitor the frozen baseline.

findings.title: Historical creator of seed WAL/SHM remains unknown
evidence: seed WAL/SHM were present before this audit and PRE/POST remained identical
findings.recommended_disposition: Continue PRE/POST attribution and never delete seed sidecars automatically.

findings.title: B01 narrative and machine-readable freeze differ for two paths
findings.recommended_disposition: Retain the approved baseline fallback and do not rewrite historical B01 evidence.
